title: Elon Musk flies a private jet everywhere. Why isn't it his? ✈️
description:
Elon Musk flies a private jet almost everywhere. So why isn't the jet his?
The answer is in Tesla's own filings: one of his companies bills another.
Sources: Tesla's proxy statement and annual report filing, reported by TechCrunch and Electrek (Apr 2024, Apr 2026). The characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
